WITH customer_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        toYear(MIN(DateKey)) AS cohort_year
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_repeat AS (
    SELECT
        f.CustomerKey,
        c.cohort_year,
        toUInt8(max(toYear(f.DateKey)) > c.cohort_year) AS came_back
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN customer_cohort c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY f.CustomerKey, c.cohort_year
)
SELECT
    cohort_year,
    count()                                          AS total_customers,
    sum(came_back)                                   AS repeat_customers,
    round(sum(came_back) * 100.0 / count(), 2)       AS repeat_pct
FROM customer_repeat
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
